snippet.title: Overwatch Rush | Early Development Gameplay Preview
snippet.description:
Overwatch Rush is a new top-down Hero shooter designed specifically for mobile and set in the Overwatch universe.

Overwatch Rush is being developed by a dedicated team at Blizzard, separate from Team 4, all of whom have deep mobile experience.

Our mission is to continue to expand the Overwatch universe by bringing fresh new adventures to players across all platforms.

Join the community: http://discord.gg/overwatchrush

#Overwatch #OverwatchRush
